source_results.outcome_status: opened before this development plan; no result is confirmatory

research_contract.target: Determine whether a tiny interpretable forecast correction learned across research repositories is worth an independent later test.
research_contract.deployment_boundary: At every target Origin, forecast from that repository's eligible historical reference-Agent Results and select only that repository's historical Tasks.
research_contract.primary_baseline: all eligible historical Tasks from the target repository
research_contract.primary_loss: mean across the three frozen public reference Agents of absolute selected-history versus future-cohort pass-rate error
non_solutions: mixing Tasks from several repositories into one Selection
using target-repository future Results during fitting or Selection
choosing an algorithm or grid point from its outer target result
claiming confirmation, strict prospectivity, or unseen-Agent transfer
changing core records or widening the production Runner

outer_evaluation.fold: hold out one complete repository; train or choose parameters on the other six
outer_evaluation.repository_weighting: Origins equal within repository; outer repositories equal
outer_evaluation.agent_treatment: the same frozen three-Agent public panel is used for historical features and future loss

selection.forecast_target: one pass-rate target per reference Agent
selection.subset_rule: deterministic dynamic program minimizing mean absolute distance between selected and forecast Agent pass-rate vectors
selection.tie_break: lexicographically earliest tuple under created_at then instance_id
selection.clipping: clip every forecast pass rate to [0, 1]

candidates.forecast: complete eligible history vector plus a training-repository mean future-minus-history drift vector
candidates.fitting: For each outer fold and shrinkage value, estimate drift with inner leave-one-repository-out fits and choose by macro inner validation loss; ties choose smaller shrinkage. Refit drift on all six outer-training repositories.

candidates.forecast: complete eligible history vector plus alpha times the latest-ten minus complete-history vector
candidates.fitting: Choose alpha on the six outer-training repositories by macro-repository loss; ties choose smaller alpha.

diagnostics.random_calibration: reuse the frozen 20,000-draw, seed-20260728 equal-budget distribution

requirements: wide macro-repository difference is at most -0.01
at least five of seven repositories have negative difference
every leave-one-repository-out summary has negative difference
candidate is better than at least 75 percent of equal-budget random draws
candidate improves the fixed history_match compression control
nomination_rule.effect: At most one candidate, ordered by wide macro loss then selector_id, is frozen for a later independent test. No production promotion is allowed.

authority.allowed_inputs: the pinned local dataset and the three already-opened official result blobs
